children: Macquarie upgrades expectations for Viva Energy's 2H refining margins, driving a 6.7% increase in its price target to A$4.00/share. Macquarie now expects a 2H refining margin of US$24.40 per barrel. That puts it around 12% above consensus hopes of US$21.84/bbl. "We also raise Viva Energy's 2027 refining margins to US$16.10/bbl given some aspects of the 2026 margin strength will persist for more than six months," Macquarie says. It notes the market for middle distillate products remains structurally tight, despite a gradual recovery of crude oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz. It estimates 5 million-6 million barrels per day of refining capacity remains offline across Russia and the Middle East. Viva Energy ended last week at A$3.21. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
